sloka: स तदा पीडितस्तेन कपिना पर्वतोत्तमः ।ररास सह तैर्भूतैः प्रविशन् वसुधातलम् ।कम्पमानैश्च शिखरैः पतद्भिरपि च द्रुमैः ।। 5.56.26 ।।।।
transliteration: sa tadā pīḍitastena kapinā parvatottamaḥ ।rarāsa saha tairbhūtaiḥ praviśan vasudhātalam ।kampamānaiśca śikharaiḥ patadbhirapi ca drumaiḥ ।। 5.56.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Pressed under the feet of Hanuman, the great mountain made loud sound sinking into the earth along with all its creatures, with its shaken mountain peaks and uprooted trees dropping down.
